|lore=
|game_text='''0 side – Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)'''<br />''Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and A Sith’s Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct.'' '''For''' remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Whenever a character hit by Galen’s Lightsaber or Vader’s Lightsaber leaves table, opponent loses 2 Force. '''While''' this side up, may take Galen’s Fighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Galen’s immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. '''Flip''' this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.<br /><br />'''7 side – Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)'''<br />'''While''' this side up, opponent’s Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any one card without ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin’s Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2. '''Flip''' this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visibly different printing is a version).
* '''Original''' ([[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Set 17)]]): the separate oversized objective sheet “Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed” (Players Committee, “Official text as of February 6, 2009”; PDF dated 6 February 2009; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/V17-Oversized.pdf V17-Oversized.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), one page with both sides of the objective as large slips, about 5 inches wide ([[:File:OVS17-17-Hunt_Down_And_Destroy_The_Jedi-oversized-2009-02-06.png]], [[:File:OVS17-17b-Their_Fire_Has_Gone_Out_Of_The_Universe-oversized-2009-02-06.png]]), with instructions to cut them out and place them over the Decipher card; game text as above. Dated by the PDF: this sheet was made two days before the set sheet's PDF (8 February 2009), both carrying the official text of 6 February 2009.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the set sheet VirtualCards17.pdf (Players Committee, official text as of 6 February 2009; PDF dated 8 February 2009; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), page 5, slip 17. '''What changed:''' nothing in the words: the set sheet prints the same two sides in the normal slip size (about 2.5 inches wide), so the printing looks different from the oversized slips. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
